verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents finding times when two or more people are free (the dynamic usernames-only slots query), collective scheduling, and calendar conflict checks. That is plain open-slot discovery, which this story explicitly goes beyond. There is no evidence of Cal.com's own AI ranking or choosing the best time, or continuously re-optimizing meetings. The MCP server and agent API only let outside AI clients query slots, which is a developer building block rather than this capability.
